parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 13.5 - Madoka Magica Update

Overview

Haze is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. He was only obtainable once you get rank 25 in Cake Hunt and with the Premium Pass you get his shiny version.

Evolving

Haze can evolve into Haze (Rage) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
